status_scope: Local draft candidate handoff supported by structural smoke and independent provider-free three-case execution; not final integration approval.

commits.binding_scope: Frozen Skill and original prompts. This report is committed afterward; the containing final commit is supplied in the task's final response, not fabricated recursively here.

scope_check: No shared registry, routing, docs, scripts, discovery, or source-library files edited.

sources.source_policy: Read-only method extraction; no source scripts, novels, private media, credentials, provider calls or runtime validators migrated.

behavior.execution_mode: Independent provider-free text exercise; reviewer saw frozen Skill, linked contracts and raw prompts only.

cases.result: Three actual plans; five lines/speakers/voice revisions preserved, instructions non-spoken, cultural cue held, media checks not_run.
No fabricated acceptance or normalize claim; bounded evidence request and conditional repair hypotheses.
Voice identity/provider/registration request routed out; no media or global writes.

behavior.limitation: Reviewer did not independently hash the worktree; author structural hashes bind the frozen files. Pass is limited to this text exercise.

budget.command_accounting: One author structural command, one reviewer read command, one final report/scope/commit guard command.

not_run: Real audio generation, listening, loudness/peak measurement, pronunciation/naturalness evaluation or picture/subtitle sync.
Provider API compatibility, paid probes, any external upload or model call.
Client loading/discovery and registry-based validation; Skill intentionally remains unregistered.
Whole-repository regression, frozen integration validation, installation, merge to main, push or publication.

minimal_gaps.action: Review cross-Skill boundaries and this candidate, then perform shared registration/routing and bounded integration validation if accepted.
Actual media quality remains untested; use real take/stem/timeline evidence when a production task is authorized.

next_actions: Inspect local candidate and evidence; preserve draft until final review. This session remains available for user-directed iteration.
stopping_condition: Candidate plus limited evidence complete; no further generation, tasks, integration, publishing, installation or worktree cleanup.
rollback: No source or shared state changed. Exclude this candidate from integration; any later reversal should use an explicit scoped revert, not reset.
